Rashi on Nedarim 46b:1:1.hebrew: כשיש בה בדי חלוקה - ארבע אמות לזה וארבע אמות לזה. וטעמא דמאן דאסר, הואיל ואפשר בחלוקה:
Rashi on Nedarim 46b:1:1.english: Where there is sufficient [area] in it for division - Four cubits for this [partner] and four cubits for this [partner]. And the reason of the one who forbids [it] is since division is possible.

Rashi on Nedarim 46b:1:2.english: But [if] there is not sufficient [area] in it [for] division, everyone [agrees it is] permitted - For what could he do?

Rashi on Nedarim 46b:2:1.english: From an entity belonging to that city - As [the Mishnah] explains: the synagogue and the ark, etc.

Rashi on Nedarim 46b:3:1.hebrew: שאין בה כדי חלוקה - ומאן דאסר, משום דכבית הכנסת דמי, דקתני דש ניהם אסורים; ומאן דשרי, הואיל ואי אפשר בחלוקה:
Rashi on Nedarim 46b:3:1.english: Where there is not sufficient [area] in it for division - And the one who forbids [does so] because it is like a synagogue, for [the Mishnah] teaches that both of them are forbidden; and the one who permits [does so] since division is impossible.

Rashi on Nedarim 46b:3:2.english: But [if] there is sufficient [area] in it for division, everyone agrees [it is] forbidden - For division suffices for him.

Rashi on Nedarim 46b:5:1.english: And how much [of a] right of usage - does the one who imposed the vow have in that bathhouse, such that this [subject of the vow] is prohibited from [using] it?

Rashi on Nedarim 46b:5:2.hebrew: אבל בבציר - מרביע, לא חשיב תפיסת יד ומותר בו המודר. וספרים דכתיב בהו בבצין, משמע נמי בבצים. ואית דגרסי בביצין, כמו ביצין של יוצר, כדאמר בב"מ (דף עד.) שהיוצר עושה כמין ביצים של חומר ומהם עושה קדרות. והכי משמע ליה: דאית ליה תשמישתא כלום, אבל כדי להניח ביצים של יוצר להתם לייבשם, אין זו תפיסת יד:
Rashi on Nedarim 46b:5:2.english: But in [a case of] less - than a quarter, it is not considered a right to usage, and the one prohibited by the vow is permitted [to use] it. And [in] texts in which it is written bebetzin, it also means bebetzim ["in eggs"]. And there are those who read bebetzin, like a potter's eggs, as it says in Bava Metzia (74a), that the potter makes a kind of eggs of clay and from them makes pots. And this is what it means to him: that he has some slight use [of the bathhouse], merely to place potter's eggs there to dry them — this is not [considered] a right to usage.

Rashi on Nedarim 46b:5:3.hebrew: אביי אמר אפי' בבציר - מרביע הוי תפיסת יד, ואסור בהם המודר. והכי נמי איכא לפרש כל הני לישני:
Rashi on Nedarim 46b:5:3.english: Abaye said: Even in [a case of] less - [than] a quarter is [considered] a right to usage, and the one bound by the vow is forbidden [to benefit] from them. And similarly, all of these readings can be explained [in this way].

Rashi on Nedarim 46b:5:4.hebrew: דמקבל בטסקא - שקיבלו השוכר לתת ממנו מס בכל שנה ושנה, דהאי לא הוי תפיסת יד כלל:
Rashi on Nedarim 46b:5:4.english: Where he receives [payment] as a fixed annual fee [taska] - That the lessee undertook [to lease] it to pay a fixed fee from it each and every year, for this is not [considered] a right to usage at all.

Tosafot on Nedarim 46b:1:1.hebrew: מחלוקת בשיש בו כדי חלוקה - דאז מתהני בחלוקה, שיכול לכוף את חבירו לחלוק, לכך לא קנסוה רבנן; אבל אין בה דין חלוקה, שאין יכול לכוף את חבירו — קנסו רבנן:
Tosafot on Nedarim 46b:1:1.english: The dispute [is] where there is sufficient [area] in it for division - For then he benefits from division, since he can compel his fellow to divide [it], therefore the Rabbis did not penalize it; but [where] there is no law of division in it, since he cannot compel his fellow [to divide it] — the Rabbis penalized [it].

Tosafot on Nedarim 46b:4:1.hebrew: אמר רב הונא הלכה כרבי אליעזר בן יעקב - וקשה, דבפרק בתרא פסקינן כרבי אושעיא דאמר: בדאורייתא אין ברירה, בדרבנן יש ברירה, והכא דאורייתא הוא! ומפרש ר"ת: דהא דפסקי' כרבי אליעזר בן יעקב — לאו מטעם דיש ברירה, אלא משום דויתור מותר במודר הנאה, וכשהדירו זה את זה מדריסת הרגל — לא נאסרו. וא"כ, לפי זה, שאם אסרו עצמם בדריסה — אסורין ליכנס לחצר, ואדם מן השוק שאסר — מותר ליכנס, דויתור מותר. ור"י פי': דפסקינן שפיר מטעמא דיש ברירה; ובביצה (דף לח:) לא פסיק כר' אושעיא אלא ממאי דאמר בדרבנן יש ברירה. הילכך, שותפין שנדרו דריסת הרגל — מותרין בחצר; ואדם מן השוק מודר הנאה מחבירו — אסור ליכנס, דויתור אסור, דאשכחן סתמא בפרקין דלעיל דויתור אסור:
Tosafot on Nedarim 46b:4:1.english: Rav Huna said: The halakha is in accordance with Rabbi Eliezer ben Yaakov - And this is difficult, for in the last chapter [of Beitzah] we rule in accordance with Rabbi Oshaya, who says: In Torah [law] there is no retroactive clarification [ein bereira], [while] in rabbinic [law] there is retroactive clarification [yesh bereira] — and here [vows] are Torah [law]! And Rabbeinu Tam explains: That which we rule in accordance with Rabbi Eliezer ben Yaakov is not for the reason that there is retroactive clarification, but rather because incidental waiving of benefit [vitur] is permitted for one who is subject to a vow prohibiting benefit, and when they vowed [not to benefit from] each other, they were not prohibited from stepping foot [in the courtyard]. And if so, according to this, [it follows] that if they [explicitly] prohibited themselves from stepping, they are prohibited from entering the courtyard; whereas a person from the street who made a vow [of prohibition] is permitted to enter, since vitur is permitted. And Ri explains: We indeed rule [like Rabbi Eliezer ben Yaakov] for the reason that there is retroactive clarification; and in Beitzah (38b), [the Gemara] does not rule in accordance with Rabbi Oshaya except with respect to what he said that in rabbinic [law] there is retroactive clarification. Therefore, partners who vowed [not to benefit from each other, even regarding] stepping foot — they are permitted [to enter] the courtyard; whereas a person from the street who is subject to a vow prohibiting benefit from his fellow is prohibited from entering, since vitur is prohibited, as we find an anonymous [Mishnah] in our previous chapter [stating] that vitur is prohibited.

Tosafot on Nedarim 46b:5:1.hebrew: למחצה לשליש ולרביע - שהמשכיר מקבל שליש הריוח, ואין לשוכר כ"א ב' חלקים — דברשותו הוא מקבל, ואסור:
Tosafot on Nedarim 46b:5:1.english: For a half, for a third, or for a quarter - [This means] that the lessor receives a third of the profit, and the lessee has only two parts — [for] he [the lessor] receives [his share] in his own right, and [therefore it is] forbidden.

Tosafot on Nedarim 46b:5:2.english: But in [a case of] less - Explanation: [With] less, [it is] permitted.

Tosafot on Nedarim 46b:5:3.hebrew: אביי אמר אפילו בבציר אסור - כך הגירסא ראשונה:
Tosafot on Nedarim 46b:5:3.english: Abaye said: Even in [a case of] less, [it is] forbidden - This is the first reading:

Tosafot on Nedarim 46b:5:4.hebrew: דמקבל בטסקא - פירוש: שמקבל השוכר מן המשכיר בכך וכך לשנה. ואיתא ספרים דגרסי: "אפילו בבצין" — פירוש: קרקע היוצר, כמו "על הבצין של יוצר" (ב"מ דף עד.), ורגילין לייבשן במרחץ; ואם רגילות להשכיר לייבש בצין של משכיר באותו מרחץ — הוה תפיסת יד:
Tosafot on Nedarim 46b:5:4.english: Where he receives an annual rental fee [taska] - Meaning, that the lessee receives [the bathhouse] from the lessor for such-and-such [an amount] per year. And there are texts that read: "Even with clay [bitzin]" — meaning potter's clay, as in "on the potter's clay" (Bava Metzia 74a), and people are accustomed to dry it in a bathhouse; and if it is customary to lease [it with a right] to dry the lessor's clay in that bathhouse, it constitutes a right to usage [tefisat yad].
